name: Citadel: Outer Ring
summary: The fortified outer defenses of the Muramite Citadel, guarded by legionnaires and siege crews.
description: The Citadel Outer Ring forms the first line of defense around the Muramite Citadel. Ramparts, gatehouses, siege platforms, and fortified corridors dominate the area. Legionnaires patrol constantly, siege crews maintain heavy weaponry, and Discord‑reinforced structures enhance defensive strength. Resistance infiltration is rare but possible through blind spots and supply routes. The Outer Ring is designed to repel assaults and channel intruders into kill zones.
